scripts.build: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false && vite build
scripts.test: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js src/tests/runTests.ts --outDir ./dist-test --target es2020 --module commonjs --moduleResolution node && node -e "fs.writeFileSync('./dist-test/package.json', JSON.stringify({type:'commonjs'}))" && node ./dist-test/tests/runTests.js
scripts.verify: node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.app.json --pretty false && node ./node_modules/typescript/lib/tsc.js --noEmit -p tsconfig.node.json --pretty false && npm run replays:check
